source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's San Antonio SAT2-SAT4 campus publishes 36 MW of IT capacity and holds PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FISMA, and TIA-942 certifications, positioning it for regulated workloads rather than large-scale AI training.

At 40 kW per rack, a common density for AI training, 36 MW supports roughly 900 racks. The campus's 295,785 square feet of technical space at that density suggests the published IT figure captures the current footprint, not future buildout.

Texas publishes capacity figures for only 19 of 133 mapped facilities. This campus ranks fourth by disclosed IT load, representing 7.6% of the state's published 475 MW. That rank reflects the scarcity of operators publishing specifications, not necessarily strategic importance to AI scaling.

The site's suitability score of 68 is based only on published IT capacity and operator type, and it lacks an announced expansion. Grid constraint and power availability for this site are not published.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
